scenarios.description: Resolve a recent Connect recording and use its ID and reader for inspection.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Run apparent connect list --limit 1 --json or invoke /apparent in an agent with the skill installed.
prerequisites: A candidate CLI, Node 22, a built Connect service and a private working directory.

runner.instructions: From connect/service, build with npm run build, set APPARENT_CONNECT_TEST_BINARY to the absolute candidate CLI path and run node --test test/native/reader-profiles.integration.ts. Run npm test for pending, ordering, access and legacy timestamp coverage.

expectedEvidence: The candidate CLI lists the expected encrypted capture ID, recording timestamp, age and ready status for each explicitly selected reader.
The candidate CLI retrieves and inspects the recording by ID using the approved reader.
limits: The fixture uses a local synthetic Connect service. It does not exercise a live account, agent slash-command registration or Desktop UI.

scenarios.description: Measure synthetic Connect share activation through verified readiness and advancing recipient playback.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Choose Share on a saved recording, then open the ready capability link.
prerequisites: Standard GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04, Node 22.23.0, pinned control and candidate revisions, and a private evidence directory.

runner.instructions: Dispatch the optional hosted benchmark with stream=connect. Follow the owner README for pinned revisions, the synthetic evidence artifact and local diagnostic replay.

expectedEvidence: An unauthenticated recipient verifies the ready manifest, all original assets match the synthetic fixture, and Chromium presents two frames with advancing media time.
A machine-readable receipt distinguishes link availability, watch readiness and advancing playback and records cold/warm milliseconds, trace coverage, resource guards and normalized score.
limits: The loopback lane uses named effect substitutes for the Desktop sender, identity and managed persistence. Chromium is headless and browser HTTP caching is disabled.
CPU accounting and topology describe the hosted Linux guest. Local diagnostic timings are outside the hosted score series.
